title: CCTE Practice Exam Question
description: One CCTC practice-exam item. Questions are tagged to the 2026-07 (new) blueprint's domain/task/knowledge codes; the legacy (until 2026-06) blueprint derives its sections via the crosswalk in blueprints/cctc-thru-2026-06.json, so a single question bank serves both exam versions.

id.description: Stable, unique id, e.g. cctc-0001. Never reuse an id; retire instead.

version.description: Bump whenever the item's content changes.

status.description: Agent output is ALWAYS 'draft'. Only a human SME promotes an item to 'reviewed'.

domain.description: 2026-07 blueprint domain: 1=Transplant Education, 2=Pre-Transplant Evaluation & Management, 3=Post-operative Monitoring, Evaluation & Reporting.

knowledge_codes.description: Specific knowledge/skill codes from the detailed content outline that this item tests, e.g. 010504.

cognitive_level.description: Used to mirror the exam's cognitive mix (~35% recall / 52% application / 13% analysis).

organ.description: Secondary spec. ~50% of items should be 'general'; the rest follow the organ weighting in the blueprint files.

recipient_age.description: The exam is mostly adult with a small pediatric share.

legacy_section.description: OPTIONAL explicit legacy-blueprint subsection override (e.g. '1A'). Normally omitted; the legacy sampler derives the section from 'task' via the crosswalk.

stem.description: The question text. Must be ORIGINAL wording — never copied or closely paraphrased from any copyrighted source. Test competency, not trickery.

shuffle.description: false = options must keep authored order (e.g. 'all of the above', 'none of the above', ordered numeric ranges, or complex_combo where element identity is fixed).

elements.description: REQUIRED for complex_combo only: the numbered statements (I, II, III...).

options.description: Answer choices. The actual ABTC exam uses four (A-D).

selects.description: complex_combo only: which elements this option asserts (e.g. ['I','II'] for 'I and II only').

correct.description: id of the single correct option. Validation script confirms it matches exactly one existing option.

rationale_correct.description: Why the correct answer is correct, in original wording.

rationale_incorrect.description: Map of each NON-correct option id to a short reason it is wrong.

primary_anchor.description: Primary source passage the item was written from. Required before promotion; used for lookup and anchor validation.

source_id.description: When type=pdf: id from scripts/reference/sources.json (e.g. cupples, danovitch, optn-policies).

section.description: Chapter/section heading at the anchor (e.g. 'Ch. 3 §h.iii Communication with the transplant team').

quote_hint.description: Short verbatim phrase from the anchor passage to speed human lookup.

keywords.description: Terms that must appear on the cited PDF page (or in url anchor notes) — validated against the reference index.

references.description: At least one source from the ABTC CCTC suggested reference list (see docs/reference/ABTC Candidate Handbook.md). Textbook citations carry ch./§/pp. locators; OPTN policy entries may cite the indexed HRSA policies PDF (Policy § + PDF p. N + #page=N url).

notes.description: Internal note for the reviewer (never shown to the user), e.g. 'Verify current MELD 3.0 components against OPTN policy before promoting to reviewed.'
